CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  MINUTES
  Regular Meeting
  May 10, 2022

  •  CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:30 P.M.

  •  ROLL CALL:
  Present: Ankit Udani, Michael Daninger, Stanley Tsai, Nora Hernandez
  •  Absent: None
  Staff Present: Vist Yang, Erin Joson

CONSENT AGENDA

All items on the consent agenda will be addressed under a single motion unless a Design Review
Board Member of a member of the public requests that the item be heard under the Discussion
Agenda.

ITEM 1: MINUTES – April 12, 2022

MOTION:
 •  Hernandez moved to approve the consent agenda as submitted.
 •  The second was by Daninger.
 •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:

  Ayes: Ankit Udani, Stanley Tsai, Michael Daninger, Nora Hernandez,
  Absent: None

DISCUSSION ITEMS:

ITEM 2: 621 Orange Grove Avenue
This is an application for a new second-story addition to an existing single-family residence.
Applicant: Kyle Imoto, Rafu Construction.
RECOMMENDED ACTION: Recommendation is for approval with the condition that the color
drawings be updated to accurately show the brick wainscot on the front elevation.

ACTION MINUTES:
The applicant was present.

  1
 Hernandez confirmed that the line drawings accurately showed the brick wainscot but colored
elevations needed to be updated. She stated that the drawings should accurately mention that the
roof material is new and will not match existing.

Udani confirmed that the front windows were the only windows with shutters.

Daninger confirmed that the window shutters were existing.

Tsai mentioned that there were discrepancies on the floor plans and elevations and noted missing
posts for the new balcony in the rear elevation.

The board discussed the posts for the new balcony interfering with the sliding door. Suggestions
were made to cantilever the balcony instead.

MOTION:
 •  Hernandez moved to approve the application with the following conditions:
  1. The rear porch posts shall be removed and the balcony be cantilevered;
  2. The colored elevations shall be revised to accurately show the brick veneer;
  3. The applicant shall work with staff on the front elevation roof line;
  4. Details and specifications shall be accurately shown on drawings; and
  5. Revised drawings shall be reviewed and approved by DRB staff prior to the Planning
  Commission hearing.
 •  The second was by Tsai.
 •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:

  Ayes: Ankit Udani, Stanley Tsai, Michael Daninger, Nora Hernandez
  Absent: None

ITEM 3: 43 East Main Street
This is an application for a Uniform Sign Program (USP) for an existing commercial building.

RECOMMENDED ACTION: Recommendation is for approval with the following conditions: 1.
The language in the USP shall be clarified to allow one Main Street facing sign per ground floor
tenant and; 2. The applicant shall work with staff on the final language within the USP with regard
to any second-floor tenant signage.

ACTION MINUTES:
The applicant was present.

Hernandez confirmed the material of the sign band is a metal panel.

The board discussed the sign types and locations and confirmed the tenants.

MOTION:
 •  Hernandez moved to approve the application with the following conditions:

  2
   1. The language in the USP shall be clarified to allow one Main Street facing sign per
  ground floor tenant; and
  2. The applicant shall work with staff on the final language within the USP with regard to
  any second-floor tenant signage.
  •  The second was by Daninger.
  •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:

  Ayes: Ankit Udani, Stanley Tsai, Michael Daninger, Nora Hernandez
  Absent: None

ITEM 4: 1600 Cabrillo Avenue
This is an application for a one-story addition and a porch to an existing single-family residence.

RECOMMENDED ACTION: Recommendation is for approval with the condition that any
MWELO compliant documents be provided during plan check.

ACTION MINUTES:
The applicant was not present.

MOTION:
 •  Hernandez moved to continue the application to the next scheduled meeting.
 •  The second was by Tsai.
 •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:

  Ayes: Ankit Udani, Stanley Tsai, Michael Daninger, Nora Hernandez
  Absent: None

ITEM 5: 2009 South Marguerita Avenue
This is an application for a new 2,684 square foot two-story single-family residence with a detached
3-car garage.

RECOMMENDED ACTION: Recommendation is for approval with the condition that any needed
MWELO landscape documents shall be provided as required at the time of plan check.

ACTION MINUTES:
The applicant was present and made note that the unit in the rear was a previously approved ADU.

Hernandez confirmed that the main house is going to be demolished.

Tsai questioned the front window sizes and types. The applicant confirmed they are all casements
for egress. Tsai suggested the two second-floor bedroom windows be made more narrow to allow
for the shutters to fit better.

Udani confirmed the color of the door is the spiced wine shown on the material board.

  3
 Tsai suggested that the vertical window trim use a different thickness than the horizontal trim to
allow for a more authentic window detail.

MOTION:
 •  Tsai moved to approve the application with the following conditions:
  1. The second-floor bedroom windows on the front elevation shall be reduced in width;
  2. A window detail showing the trim depths shall be included in the drawing set;
  3. The notation about the garage being converted to a pool house shall be updated; and
  4. All revised drawings shall be reviewed and approved by DRB staff prior to Planning
  Commission hearing.
 •  The second was by Hernandez.
 •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:

  Ayes: Ankit Udani, Stanley Tsai, Michael Daninger, Nora Hernandez
  Absent: None

ADJOURNMENT:
Udani stated that the next DRB meeting is May 24, 2022.

MOTION:
 •  Hernandez moved to adjourn the meeting at 8:11 pm.
 •  Seconded by Daninger
 •  The motion carried 4-0 by the following roll call vote:

  Ayes: Ankit Udani, Stanley Tsai, Michael Daninger, Nora Hernandez
  Absent: None

PASSED, APPROVED AND ADOPTED this 24th day of March, 2022.

  _____________________________
  Nora Hernandez, Vice Chairman

ATTEST:

_______________________
Steve Kuchenski
Secretary/City Architect
